title: RSL source-system contracts and fixture adapters
scope: Versioned read contracts and explicit fixture adapters for e-Tax declared positions, Lekuka/IDMS invoices (with supplier output-VAT declaration), Online Refunds Application claims, RSL refund-fraud model scores and ASYCUDA World entries, published through a WSO2-shaped gateway boundary

acceptance.text: One versioned contract per RSL system with decimal-string Maloti amounts, ISO dates, tenant and taxpayer scope and source provenance (system, record ID, retrieved_at, contract version); every shape is marked as an assumption pending RSL specification and no real host, path or field name is invented

Fixture adapters read synthetic data only and identify themselves as fixtures in every response; RSL's fraud score is carried as an RSL-owned input with model ID/version and never relabelled as a Vati score; the TAX-073 customs fixture is mapped to the ASYCUDA contract

Tests: contract validation rejects missing provenance, float money and cross-tenant reads; an unavailable source is reported as unavailable, never replaced by an invented value; Vati stores references and hashes, not a second invoice store
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Tests: contract validation rejects missing provenance, float money and cross-tenant reads; an unavailable source is reported as unavailable, never replaced by an invented value; Vati stores references and hashes, not a second invoice store

evidence.text: integration/rsl_sources/contracts.py: one contract per RSL record kind (e-Tax vat/wht/cit/paye, IDMS invoice and supplier integration, Online Refunds claim, RSL fraud score, ASYCUDA entry, registry entity, Central Bank payment), IDs ending -assumed, decimal-string Maloti, ISO dates, taxpayer scope; fixture_source.py envelopes carry source system, record ID, contract ID, retrieved_at and record SHA-256.

Every envelope has fixture: true; RSL score contract requires owner RSL with model ID/version and the pipeline reports it as RSL's; asycuda_entries_from_tax073 maps the TAX-073 customs fixture (test_tax073_customs_values_map_to_asycuda_contract).

tests/integration/test_rsl_sources.py (8 tests): float money, missing and unexpected fields refused; cross-tenant read refused; unavailable source returns status unavailable with no records; duplicate IDs refused; references kept, not copies.
